title: Diesel vs Gas vs Hybrid Truck in 2026: The $6.51 Diesel Shock Changed the Math
description:
Six dollars and fifty-one cents. In September twenty twenty-six, the average price of diesel in America hit an all-time record, according to AAA. For decades, truck owners were told that diesel pays off in the long run. But when diesel costs two dollars more per gallon than gasoline, that old rule breaks. And the numbers show something that would have sounded crazy just one year ago.
